input_exclusion_rule: Exclude a test record iff its original SMILES_clean and original numeric logTg both match at least one original development record. All retained fields and labels are unchanged from the original published test CSV.
development_label_rule: same exact SMILES_clean groups with original K spread>10 use shared group K median; other labels preserved
test_label_source: Original author-released data/processed/test_data.csv; logTg preserved exactly.
